# DRIVE-TRACE -- what each scenario does to the CSMS.
# Generated by tools/extract-drive-trace.ts. Do not hand-edit.
# Operations are normalised: OCPP action + argument VALUES (keys
# discarded, lowercased, sorted), so a pure driver-syntax change is
# invisible here while a dropped or retargeted step is not.

  SPEC cert16-tc014-soft-reset

    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc017-unlock-occupied

  SPEC cert16-tc019-get-configuration-all

  SPEC cert16-tc024-lock-failure

  SPEC cert16-reservation-basic

GROUP remotetrigger-smartcharging
  SPEC cert16-tc010-remote-start
    OP RemoteStartTransaction [1, cert-tag-1]
    OBS latest-transaction
    OP RemoteStopTransaction [txpk]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc011-remote-start-stop
    OP RemoteStartTransaction [1, cert-tag-2]
    OBS latest-transaction
    OP RemoteStopTransaction [txpk]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc012-remote-stop
    OBS latest-transaction
    OP RemoteStopTransaction [txpk]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc026-remote-start-rejected
    OBS latest-transaction
    OP RemoteStartTransaction [1, cert-tag-1]
    -> driveState keys=[baselineTxPk]
  SPEC cert16-tc028-remote-stop-rejected
    OBS wait-active-transaction
    OP RemoteStopTransaction [txpk]
    -> driveState keys=[txPk]
  SPEC cert16-tc054-trigger-message
    OP TriggerMessage [heartbeat]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc055-trigger-message-rejected
    OP TriggerMessage [heartbeat]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc056-central-smart-charging-txdefault
    OBS latest-transaction
    OBS charging-profile-by-description
    OP SetChargingProfile [1, profilepk]
    -> driveState keys=[profilePk,txPk]
  SPEC cert16-tc057-central-smart-charging-txprofile
    OBS wait-active-transaction
    OBS charging-profile-by-description
    OP SetChargingProfile [1, profilepk, txpk]
    -> driveState keys=[profilePk,txPk]
  SPEC cert16-tc059-remote-start-with-profile
    OBS charging-profile-by-description
    OP RemoteStartTransaction [1, cert-tag-1, profilepk]
    -> driveState keys=[profilePk]
  SPEC cert16-tc066-get-composite-schedule
    OBS charging-profile-by-description
    OP SetChargingProfile [1, profilepk]
    SIM wait-for-line Applied charging profile #PROFILEPK(?!\d) 10000
    OP GetCompositeSchedule [1, 600, w]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert16-tc067-clear-charging-profile
    OBS charging-profile-by-description
    OP SetChargingProfile [1, profilepk]
    SIM wait-for-line Applied charging profile #PROFILEPK(?!\d) 10000
    OP ClearChargingProfile [profilepk]
    -> driveState keys=[]

GROUP core-201
  SPEC cert201-tcb01-cold-boot
    <no drive>
  SPEC cert201-tcb20-reset-accepted
    OP 201:Reset [immediate]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert201-tcb21-reset-scheduled
    SIM send {"command":"start_transaction","params":{"connector":1,"tagId":"CERT-TAG-1"}}
    SIM wait-for-line Sent: \[2,.*"TransactionEvent" 10000
    OP 201:Reset [onidle]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert201-tcb22-reset-rejected
    OP 201:Reset [9, immediate]
    -> driveState keys=[]
  SPEC cert201-tcf20-heartbeat
    SIM send {"command":"heartbeat"}
    -> driveState keys=[]
